purpose: Global neighbor discovery around the ULTRA-VSR 36K-48K Faithful Restoration Research Stack. These candidates expand the expert mesh and quality-evaluation perimeter without becoming automatic runtime dependencies.

newDiscoveries.name: PS-SR
newDiscoveries.notes: CVPR 2026 method using a strong base model followed by lightweight speculative refinement; frequency-domain update is designed to add high-frequency detail while preserving low-frequency structure.

newDiscoveries.name: DGAF-VSR
newDiscoveries.notes: CVPR 2026 method with optical-guided warping and feature-wise temporal conditioning; reported gains cover perceptual quality, fidelity and temporal consistency.

newDiscoveries.name: STCDiT
newDiscoveries.notes: CVPR 2026 method using motion-aware segment reconstruction and anchor-frame latent guidance for structural fidelity and temporal consistency under complex camera motion.

newDiscoveries.name: AVSR-Diff
newDiscoveries.notes: ECCV 2026; decouples scale-agnostic latent denoising from continuous coordinate rendering and adds temporally gated recurrence plus scale-aware Fourier refinement.

newDiscoveries.name: FlashVSR
newDiscoveries.notes: CVPR 2026; one-step streaming VSR with locality-constrained sparse attention and a tiny conditional decoder. Official documentation says the method scales to ultra-high resolutions but recommends 4x as the practical stability setting.

newDiscoveries.name: Vivid-VR
newDiscoveries.notes: ICLR 2026; uses a text-to-video diffusion transformer foundation with restoration-guided sampling and long-video aggregation. It is not placed on the unrestricted path because its required CogVideoX, CogVLM2/Llama and EasyOCR assets carry separate terms.

newDiscoveries.name: HiRT
newDiscoveries.notes: 2026 publication/repository; hierarchical recurrent propagation uses forward/backward and bidirectional stages with global/local/image transformer blocks and frequency-domain propagation.

newDiscoveries.name: TIG-SVQA
newDiscoveries.notes: AAAI 2026; explicitly models temporal inconsistency in SR video quality assessment and localizes unstable regions.

newDiscoveries.name: TSAR
newDiscoveries.notes: 2026 Neurocomputing framework using artifact-guided temporal sampling plus motion vectors and residual maps from compressed video streams. Relevant for archived compressed sources.

newDiscoveries.name: TCSAF
newDiscoveries.notes: 2026 reference-based VSR using a learnable reference bank updated from super-resolved frames and cross-attention for alignment; useful when trustworthy high-resolution references exist.

newDiscoveries.name: FDI-VSR
newDiscoveries.notes: 2025 open-access framework integrating dynamic offsets, temporal aggregation and frequency-spatial integration; useful as a non-diffusion comparator for high-frequency reconstruction.

newDiscoveries.name: SAVSR
newDiscoveries.notes: AAAI method for arbitrary, non-integer and asymmetric spatial scales; valuable as a pre-diffusion continuous-scale comparator.

newDiscoveries.name: Self-Blind-VSR
newDiscoveries.notes: Self-supervised blind VSR line; useful for source videos whose degradation kernel is unknown or differs from synthetic training assumptions.

newDiscoveries.name: Deep-Blind-VSR
newDiscoveries.notes: Blind VSR baseline from the same research lineage; useful for testing whether explicit degradation estimation improves robustness.

observerEvidence.ITU_R_BT_500: television image quality and expert viewing methodology
